guardrails.name: Zero Polling Overhead
guardrails.description: Never introduce setInterval() or polling loops in extension/content.js or ytm-*.js. State extraction must be strictly reactive via HTML5 <video> events and scoped MutationObserver callbacks.

guardrails.name: Context Isolation Boundary
guardrails.description: MAIN World scripts (content.js, ytm-*.js) have zero access to chrome.* APIs. ISOLATED World (bridge.js) has zero access to YouTube DOM or #movie_player. Communication is strictly bidirectional via window.postMessage.

guardrails.name: In-Memory Asset Pipeline
guardrails.description: Album cover art, thumbnails, and dynamic canvas drawings must remain strictly in RAM as Base64 Data URLs. Never write intermediate image assets to disk.

guardrails.name: Hardware Refresh Limit (10 Hz)
guardrails.description: Programmatic updates to Stream Deck keys, canvas drawings, and LCD touchstrips must never exceed 10 updates per second (10 Hz).

guardrails.name: Strict Typing Discipline
guardrails.description: Prohibited in TypeScript: 'as any', '@ts-ignore', '@ts-expect-error'. All types and settings must be defined or extended in plugin/src/types/.

guardrails.name: Clean Production Logging
guardrails.description: No orphaned console.log() or console.debug() statements in plugin production code. Use the dedicated project logger.
